description_en: Configures whether the SM certificate feature is enabled for a domain name
description_zh: 调用SetCdnDomainSMCertificate设置某域名下国密证书功能是否启用
kebab_example: aliyun cdn set-cdn-domain-sm-certificate --domain-name example.com --cert-identifier 12340000-cn-hangzhou --ssl-protocol on --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetCdnDomainSMCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name to which the certificate belongs.

The certificate must be of the HTTPS secure acceleration type
parameters.help_zh:
证书所属的加速域名。

证书需属于HTTPS加速类型
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the SM certificate.
Format: Certificate ID + "-cn-hangzhou".
For example, if the certificate ID is 123, set CertIdentifier to "123-cn-hangzhou"
parameters.help_zh:
国密证书ID。
证书ID+"-cn-hangzhou"。
如果证书ID=123，CertIdentifier="123-cn-hangzhou"
parameters.name: cert_identifier

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the HTTPS certificate. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。取值：

on：启用。
off：不启用
parameters.name: ssl_protocol
